message.subject: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Thank you for your offer. To go ahead we propose the attached terms: unit price EUR 5.05, payment days 90, contract months 24. We look forward to your confirmation.

The kit puts the whole annual volume of all 4 parts with one supplier: 2070000 pieces a year, of which 1308000 pieces a year are delivered by other suppliers today. Our forecast fc:360012@2026-09 for part:360012 is 654000 pieces a year. Our forecast fc:360030@2026-09 for part:360030 is 736000 pieces a year. As you told us (doc:20260514-70610-M3), you can take additional parts at short notice and your second shift is on hold; this volume fills it. Please reflect the full kit volume in your price.

message.subject: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Thank you for your offer. To go ahead we propose the attached terms: unit price EUR 5.16, payment days 90, contract months 24. We look forward to your confirmation.

On your question about volume: with this package we commit bindingly to 30000 kits a year for the full 24 months, 60000 kits in total, all 2070000 pieces a year from one supplier, 1308000 of them moved from other suppliers. That is our full need; please price it. As changes above 2 % need your pricing committee, please put this package to the committee so your answer carries its approval.
